notes.title: Patch 1.6.C: Balance, fixes and a word from The Captain
notes.content:
[h3]Hi! I'm back with a tiny little update from the team for you.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"][/img]
[/p][h3]Patch notes:[/h3][p][b]Balance:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Fragment Disruptions giving discounts to all items in a Resource Outpost now give a discount to the first two items you buy instead[/p][/*][*][p]The Flotation Device now has a more accurate tooltip, and its effect triggers for every 5 seconds spent in the air instead of every 3 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Made various fixes to the Player list menu (for managing players and giving lives in multiplayer), and in particular made it work well on a controller again![/p][/*][*][p]Discounted prices and discount labels in the Research Outpost weren't updating correctly after manifesting an item, but now they do![/p][/*][*][p]We also fixed an issue where discounts that applied to X number of items didn't update properly. But now they do![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Settings and interface:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The tutorial now defaults to showing the trigger rather than a face button as the default Dive button on a controller. The old setup inadvertently told new players that you don't need to bother with the camera while you're diving - which you often do![/p][/*][*][p]Increased default gamepad camera sensitivity to make it feel a little more snappy and responsive without having to dive into the settings menu.
[/p][/*][/list][p]About the change to the Fragment Disruptions: The old version was pretty strong to begin with, and got stronger and stronger the more Sparks you have... so we made them strong in a different way instead! They no longer allow you to manifest a ton of items at very low cost just because you have a lot of Sparks, but on the other hand it's usable beyond the first Research Outpost you visit, if you choose not to use it - or if it's early in a run and you don't have enough Sparks to make use of it. Let us know whether this feels like an improvement! [/p][p][/p][p][b]There's also been some fun stuff happening on the Discord lately! There has been a popularity poll, and the winner- Wait, this can't be right?[/b] [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/2c3044f18bb06cb843b2fc9e28fccb8266393cd6.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello! It's your favourite - everyone's favourite - Captain![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]The public has spoken about who they want to hear from, and while I am of course humbled by this honor no one should be surprised by this. [/p][p][/p][p]To reward my faithful crew I'm going to add some patch notes. You like items, so now all items are free! However, you cannot aspire to greatness without challenge, so the speed of the Collapse is now 300% faster! [/p][p][/p][p]Anyone who starts a Fragment by saying "I need help, Captain!" gets 100% Boost. Sometimes guidance from others is the only way- [/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]No no no! That isn't how this works! Changes don't happen just because I say so. Trust me, if it worked that way, I would have forced the devs to add romanceable characters long ago… [/b][/p][p][/p][p]Besides, you barely edged out Zoe! And there were lots of other fan favourites in there who deserved to win just as much as you! Ahem. [/p][p][/p][p]I should cool off a little. 
[/p][p][b]Here's some community art to calm down with![/b] 
[/p][p]Zoe by Ln(1).rar[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/e92514384edc191a2a8cbf6a9973f66f961dbc71.png"][/img][/p][p]Art by Gottem[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/365f59e91f3e32426c37c6ba667b237a5155ae2e.png"][/img][/p][p]Art by Noname[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/b21dfd0aa0e86192489863003701f405f41a58a0.png"][/img][/p][h3]See you out there in the worlds![/h3][h3]
[/h3][h3]/Riza[/h3][h3]
[/h3]

notes.title: Hotfix: 1.6.b
notes.content: [h3]Hi, I'm predictably back with a little hotfix for you! [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The team has been breathing a sigh of relief that nothing seems to have caught fire despite the size of the update! However, there were still some small issues to iron out. The team is also going to keep an eye out for issues that crop up and for feedback on the new items and balance changes over the weekend, so please keep sharing your thoughts on the new update, both if your feedback is positive and if it is... constructive! [/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Features: [/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fragment Disruptions now have a setting allowing you to adjust their frequency between 0%-200% (defaults to 100% on all difficulties)[/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Balance changes:[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Minor equalising of Fragment Disruptions to make some negative and positive versions of the same effect equally likely to appear (we're talking probability changes of 1-2% here, nothing to worry about)[/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Fixes:[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the visuals for the new item Risk and Reward[/p][/*][*][p]Notifications now animate correctly even if you have the Item View screen open[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed controller navigation for the Unlocked Items screen that Gan is in charge of[/p][/*][*][p]Endless now has its own Fragment Disruption set, which does not contain Research Outpost Discounts or the permanent boost bonus. We also temporarily removed the Disruptions giving items until they can be properly fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the map and notification icons for the temporary and permanent Boost increase Fragment Disruptions (they were inverted)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Enjoy![/h3][h3][/h3][h3]/Riza[/h3]

notes.title: The Perfect Shard Update!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hi everyone![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"][/img][/p][p][b]We've got a huge update for you today, with new features, new items, and multiplayer improvements. It also brings us one particularly wonderful new face that I'm sure you're going to- Well, I've been told that there's something else I absolutely need to talk about first, so let's get it over with:[/b]
[/p][h3][b]Fragment Disruptions:[/b] [/h3][p]Fragments in shard runs now have various modifiers and effects, such as gaining or losing Sparks, gaining Boost or Items, increased difficulty and obstacles, and more! It should make choosing a path on the map much more interesting and give you greater control over what kind of run you have!
[/p][p]You'll now have to think a little bit more about what kind of path you take, depending on what kind of effects you would like or not like, or if you want to pick the prettiest path available to you![/p][p]Fragment Disruptions gradually increase over the course of the game, with none in Shard 1, and reach their full potential in Shard 10.[/p][p][/p][p][b]There, done! I can finally talk about the best new addition:[/b]
[/p][h3][b]The Hungry Weeboh!!![/b][/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/b1f96d410c17758968a014b785d95ac80df52971.png"][/img][b]Isn't he just adorable?? I could sit and listen to him play all day long, if not for the fact that I need to be out there looking for items to bring him.[/b]
[/p][p][b]Ahem. Here's how it works:[/b][/p][p]Rest stops now have a new character who will happily accept any item you might offer for donation. This gives you ways of getting rid of unwanted items, and possibly get something more useful in return!
[/p][p][b]Make sure to pay him a visit! Tell him Riza says hi![/b]
[/p][h3][b]New Items[/b][/h3][p]There are now various new items utilising Boost Rings in various ways, allowing for new kinds of builds. There are also a few new Luck-based items to make Luck-based builds more interesting and impactful.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm going to let you discover what they are for yourself, but take my word for it - they're a lot of fun!
[/p][h3][b]Item Effect tooltips[/b][/h3][p]The Item View now has tooltips explaining what the different item effects actually do in the game! The dev team has decided to include this despite the fact that it will deprive many users on our Discord of their main livelihoods, when people no longer come online to ask what Luck does.
[/p][p]There's a setting to disable it if you don't like the way it looks, or if you already know what everything does. Or if you'd prefer to come and ask on our Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]I know how much fun it is to run with friends, so I made sure that the dev team paid some attention to all the suggestions you have been offering![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Multiplayer Improvements[/b][/h3][p]You can now give another player one of your Lives - as long as you have one to spare! You can do it at any time by using the new interaction in the Player List.[/p][p]In the Research Outpost you can now also send one of your items to another player, which we're sure you're only going to use to help and support each other. Talk to Dalil to figure it out![/p][p]Finally there's also now a setting to have players spawn Boost Rings in their wake, which makes it more beneficial to follow in your friends' footsteps.
[/p][p]It really makes it feel like a cooperative experience now! If it's the end of the world it's better if we're in it together, right?
[/p][h3][b]Spark Rebalance[/b][/h3][p]We have rebalanced the rate at which you get Sparks and the amount of Sparks items cost, so that actually collecting Sparks in levels becomes more impactful. Some of the new items lean into this as well![/p][p][/p][p]I'm not sure how I feel about the dev team meddling with my hard-earned Sparks, but they promise that this is going to make for a more fun game...
[/p][p]Oh, and here's another thing that many many many of you have requested:
[/p][h3][b]Use Sparks in Endless![/b][/h3][p]Whenever you're offered an item in Endless you can now spend Sparks to reroll your selection. This adds a little more strategy to long-distance Endless runs.[/p][p][/p][p]The team has also added a setting for using the new Fragment Disruptions in Endless Mode! Since you don't choose the path yourself, they'll be chosen randomly, but this is for those that want a little extra spice with their snack of Endless.[/p][p][/p][p][b]This one is going to be very important for some of you, so I'll highlight it as well:[/b]
[/p][h3][b]New Setting for Visual Distortions[/b][/h3][p]There's a new setting in the options to disable some visual distortion filters, which was apparently causing headaches for some players. If that's you, go and switch it off right away!
[/p][p]If all of this seems like a lot, that's because it is! Our testers have helped immensely here and deserve a special shoutout for bringing this leviathan of an update to life. Haste wouldn't be what it is without you!
[/p][p]That brings us to the end of the feature list, but the team has also included a small collection of item changes, a bunch of bug fixes and a few QoL improvements. Check the full list below!
[/p][h2]Patch Notes:[/h2][h3]Features[/h3][list][*][p]Fragment Disruptions: A new system that makes different Fragments in a Shard have different effects. Choose your path carefully![/p][/*][*][p]The Hungry Weeboh: A new character at Rest Stops that lets you get rid of an unwanted item - and who might offer you something in exchange![/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer Improvements: Increased cooperation and interactivity.[/p][/*][*][p]Reroll Endless items![/p][/*][*][p]Item Effect tooltips: We actually explain most of the core features of the game now![/p][/*][*][p]New items: 9 new items for you to discover, including passing through Boost Rings as a new way of triggering item effects![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Balance Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Reduced base Spark gain from Fragments by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Research Outpost item costs by 25%[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced the starting Collapse Speed for Shards 8-10, and slightly increased their ending Collapse Speed, meaning that it should be slightly easier to get started and slightly harder to finish.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Item balance[/h3][p][b]Item balance is an ongoing concern, so please keep giving us feedback on items that aren't quite living up to expectations, or if you've found fun ways of combining them![/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Wingspan now has an increased Cooldown. It's still dangerous, but offers a little bit of grace. Reduced the Cooldown of Steel Hat Lining, hopefully making it more viable as a very intentional protective measure[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the Cooldown for Experimental Thrusters[/p][/*][*][p]Brittle Breastplate now only does 25 damage instead of 50. Does that make it TOO GOOD? Absolutely not, but now you might actually use it.[/p][/*][*][p]Shortcut has increased its duration from 2 to 5 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Boost from Well Earned Confidence increased from 2.5% to 5%[/p][/*][*][p]Heir's Determination now also gives +5 Speed (making up for some of the speed usually lost when taking damage)[/p][/*][*][p]Blood Engine now gives 8 damage instead of 5, but has its Boost increased to 15% for 6 seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p]Made various improvements to navigating menus with a controller, particularly to the Shard Settings screen[/p][/*][*][p]Items in the Research Outpost now show a discount label if their price is reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Items from your current run are now displayed on the "Run End" screen
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the description for Experimental Autopilot (yes, we actually did it this time)[/p][/*][*][p]The Wobbler Skin now unlocks immediately when the conditions are met so it'll be easier for you to figure out what you got it for[/p][/*][*][p]The extra buttons on the main menu (for Credits, Discord and Multiplayer) now disappear correctly when you open the Settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the first time you opened the Item View with a controller it would not let you actually inspect the Items you had[/p][/*][*][p]It's no longer possible to bring up the Item View while in Interactions or on the Shard Complete screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added some missing tags for Items (for random item selection in Encounters)[/p][/*][*][p]The Outfit Selection UI can no longer be scrolled horizontally. There wasn't anything to be found there, but that didn't stop some of you from checking.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed getting the Disaster Completed message before actually finishing Disaster Mode. Some of you might get this message for a second time the first time you open this update, but after that it should be fixed![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Ascension Crowns sometimes not appearing correctly in multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some Ascension effects not starting properly in multiplayer for late joiners[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unlocking the next ascension level sometimes not functioning correctly for multiplayer late-joiners[/p][/*][/list][h3]Modding[/h3][list][*][p]SkinDatabase.GetSkin() now returns the Default skin by... default[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Phew, that was a lot! I hope you all enjoy this huge update![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Ahaha, you didn't really think I was going to let you go without looking at our community art, did you?
[/b][/p][p][b]Let me present:[/b][/p][p]This Zoe art by [url="https://linktr.ee/Aviarasart"]Aviarasart[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/b2deba3f885463672237fdd1467cbab881e4c2bf.png"][/img][/p][p]This amazing pixel art animation by [url="https://www.instagram.com/thehiyacinth/"]thehiyacinth[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/7d76f8a179fbf3ee3878e9b485d63a1e411c46d1.gif"][/img][/p][p]This Wraith art from RocketPotatoL62[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/b54a64cffb6ee42c3356307dfc8d4de360a14e8f.png"][/img][/p][p]Gan art by [url="http://temporalresearchstation.tumblr.com/"]Elliot![/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/9ae7c41a0fc20af2efed99e4cab4a3ab83d1bd47.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This Zoe pixel art by [url="https://www.instagram.com/peri_pixels/?igsh=dnByY3NkMGx1NzB5#"]Peri[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/90773dda9ad81752f9de611de9f03e62b36f3c55.png"][/img][/p][p]Enjoy the new update and join the[url="http://discord.gg/hastebrokenworlds"] discord[/url] to see more art![/p][p][/p][h3][b]/Riza[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.5.c: Fixes & Flopsy!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png[/img]
[h3]Hey everyone! It's finally happening! As we speak, the team has put out an update that will let you dress up Zoe in the outfit of none other than Flopsy the Lovable Clown!!![/h3]

I know a lot of you have been clamouring for this day, so I won't keep you too long, but there are a couple of fixes in today's update as well.

Without further barely-contained-Flopsy-excitement, here are the [b]patch notes:[/b]

[h3]New Content:[/h3]
- Enabled the Flopsy the Lovable Clown outfit!
- Enabled the dark and mysterious Twisted Flopsy outfit!

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
- Disaster Crowns now correctly appear for all players in Disaster Mode
- The text for the Invite Screen now works correctly in all languages
- Added missing localization to some dialogue scenes in some languages
- Visual and performance improvements to the multiplayer running trails

That's all for today! Please keep reporting any issues you run into on the [url=https://discord.gg/hastebrokenworlds]Discord server[/url] or the Steam forums!

[b]Oh, all right, it's not actually all. There's so much beautiful community art being posted, so I encourage everyone to have a look on our Discord server! Here's some of my favourites lately:[/b]

I wish I could say I had any self-control, but I can't resist a Weeboh post:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8995d216e4acbdc79fac83965463ad87cd758d07.png[/img]
[b]By [url=https://ishva.carrd.co/]Ish[/url]![/b]

Apparently I am supposed to also include non-Weeboh art, so... Oh, this will do nicely! This will do very nicely indeed!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/a49c0480c022b4e477b0b14bf782b4f44e16100e.jpg[/img]
[b]By [url=https://www.instagram.com/sxushii/]Sushi[/url]![/b]

[h3]See you out there in the worlds! /Riza[/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.5.b: Fixes for the run together update!
notes.content: [h3]Hi again, everyone! You seem to have stayed busy in the one day I've been away. The team has also been busy, so they already have a small patch for you! [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Most importantly, it fixes the problem where mouse users weren't able to buy Abilities from the rest of the crew. Or to back out of the dialogue, either, leaving games locked until you shut it down. Woooops! Anyways, it's all better now, so you can spend your Antisparks to your heart's content! [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]We also fixed the problem where you would sometimes take damage from passing through the large Agency structure with a... scary burny thing in the middle. Turns out it was some misplaced invisible colliders, and [i]not[/i] a clever Agency trap the way I thought... Here's the full list of fixes:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]The Ability buying screen buttons now work with mouse input again!,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect colliders on the large "Stronghold" obstacles with the lava orb,[/p][/*][*][p]Skins are now previewed when you consider whether to buy them or not, which should make the choice easier!,[/p][/*][*][p]Zoe's Weeboh Outfit illustration now correctly displays her hair. Now you get to see those delicious cinnamon buns even when she's wearing the Weeboh hoodie!,[/p][/*][*][p]Changed steam invite button text from "Open Steam" to "Invite" for clarity,[/p][/*][*][p]Added some more description texts to the Invite Screen, [i]also[/i] for clarity,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dialouges sometimes appearing in the wrong interactions,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a handful of typose,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Weeboh skin boost level and grappling hook visuals (Oh no, the best outfit was broken???),[/p][/*][*][p]Emote Wheel selection will now close when in a Dialogue or when receiving an item. Emote freely without worrying about freezing the game!,[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the wonderful but deeply troubled Weeboh Rescue challenge from the encounter pool (at least for now, might come back later).,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Lastly, I know that you've all been looking forward to meeting Flopsy the Lovable Clown, but you'll have to wait just a liiittle bit longer for that. It'll be worth it! [/h3][p][/p][h3][b]See you out there in the worlds! /Riza[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/154b2c1b1134c0e59dace29ecd15eeac09f04f1e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Big Run Together Update - ONLINE CO-OP!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello runners! I’m thrilled to present you with a new Haste update - this time we’re bringing you ONLINE MULTIPLAYER CO-OP![/b] 
[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png"][/img][/p][p][b]That’s right! For a while now, the devs have said that multiplayer would be unlikely, but in secret, they’ve spent the last couple of months after release making it possible![/b] [i](You have no idea how hard it’s been to keep this from you all!) ((Some of you would also say we’ve done a terrible job keeping it secret.))[/i][/p][p][b]You can now play through the entire game with other Zoes! It's cooperative in that you work together to progress, but we also keep track of player times in levels, which allows for some friendly and pleasant competition[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Xep6cefa_lI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]You can join friends through Steam's invite system or by using specific join links if you set your room privacy to public. There's no separate mode or anything, you just jump smoothly straight into their game at any point, with every shard and every part of the game playable together! Multiplayer has been designed for up to 4 players. No one will stop you from playing with a whole swarm, but you might need a fast computer and fast internet![/p][p][/p][p]The team has also added skins for Zoe, so it will now be possible to change her outfit and her hat! Skins can be bought with Antisparks from the Fashionable Weeboh, and can be shown off in multiplayer. (I’m thinking of asking for a makeover myself!) There are also special skins that can be unlocked by doing special actions, such as completing the story mode or the first level of Disaster Mode.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/a55d6f2ef4f61c3e25f15a922d592fd0fc93b05a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Other changes:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Some obstacles have had their art updated, making the Agency more intimidating (and visually and technically consistent).[/p][/*][*][p]We've added a chunk of new character interactions, revealing more of their backgrounds and keeping rest stops and coffee breaks fresher for longer! This means you can get to know me and the crew even better![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Disaster Mode localisation for Swedish.[/p][/*][*][p]Once again increased the chance of getting Coffee Interactions in the research outpost. Hopefully it sticks this time![/p][/*][*][p]Hitting the pillars of one of the big Agency Platform obstacles no longer turns the main platform into an intangible death trap.[/p][/*][*][p]Flat Item stat bonuses no longer scale with your metaprogression level for that stat.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a missing homage to Flopsy the Lovable Clown[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][url="https://mightymerch.store/collections/haste"]Also don't forget to check out our new Haste merch here![/url][/p][p][/p][h2]See you out there![/h2][h2]- Riza[/h2][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update: New Disaster Game Mode!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/1c47fbfa5188bc092f16187c528cd0d0c91b5909.png[/img]

[h3]Hi everyone![/h3]
I’m thrilled to share that the dev team has cooked up something extra exciting for this patch! 
I’ve been told that some of you are craving an extra layer of challenge in Haste (because apparently the imminent destruction of the entire universe wasn’t enough!) so I think you’ll enjoy what they’ve got in store for you today.

[b]Introducing…[/b]

[h2]Disaster Mode![/h2]

Ta-daa! Trust me, it’s not as scary as it sounds. It’s [i]scarier[/i]!!

[b]Disaster Mode[/b] is a new game mode that offers the [b]most intense[/b] version of Haste yet!
[list]
[*] There are [b]4[/b] distinct levels of difficulty, applied to the Final Shard.
[*] The mode adds new dynamic obstacles, such as burning [b]Lava Flowers[/b] and more!
[*] Various [b]new effects[/b] are added to increase difficulty.
[/list]
[b]You need to complete the Final Shard to unlock the first level of Disaster Mode! Then, you can unlock each new level by completing the previous one. [/b]

I’m not going to give away all the mode’s secrets here (even though I [i]reeeally[/i] want to!) so you’ll need to find out for yourself what each level has in store…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/154b2c1b1134c0e59dace29ecd15eeac09f04f1e.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved Ultrawide support
[/list]
[b]That’s it for the team’s latest updates, so now it’s time for me to share more of my favourite art from the [url=http://discord.gg/hastebrokenworlds]Discord[/url]![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/ef2435dc64e31f8ff45491d4fc760be4b2239efd.png[/img]
This gorgeous piece is by [b]RocketPotatoL62[/b]! I love the colours!!

notes.title: Patch 1.3.b: Restart shard, balancing and bug fixes! ✨
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone!✨[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/8c62a14274e4275a143ddd3e5f1933b3eee44dda.png[/img]

[h3][b]The Haste team is hard at work on some really exciting things, and the first of those things is coming soon! Let's just say it will be a bit of a disaster! (Hm, that sounded a lot better in my head...)

In the meantime, I'm here with a small update for you with some balance changes, bug fixes and quality of life improvements.[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/3513a87073d9ace9b03aafec36977549589a505e.png[/img]


[h3]Restart Shard[/h3]
Oh, there's now an option to restart a Shard Run directly without stopping by the Hub World! This should be a very welcome addition for a lot of players.
Simply choose "Abandon Shard" and you'll get the choice between restarting or going back to the Hub World. Be careful, though! You won't earn Antisparks if you do a quick restart.

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
The team has tweaked the difficulty of the Shards quite a bit, to make the difficulty of each Shard more of a curve. Personally, I think they have really improved the pattern, so that most Shards are now a little easier when you start a run (and have no items), but are harder towards the end when you hopefully have a little more item support with you!

I have also seen a lot of comments about a "Snake" out there on runs. I've never seen it, so I don't really understand what people are complaining about. Meeting a snake sounds like it would be cute! Anyways, see if you like it better now!

[h3]Localization[/h3]
There were how many lines missing in other languages than English??? Anyways, they should mostly be in now... 😄

[h3]Bug fixes,[/h3]
[mumble] timeline refactor... energy gain rate... save swapping...

I don't even know what half of these words mean!

Anyways, enjoy the full patch notes here:

[h3]Patch Notes,[/h3]
[b]QoL[/b]
[list]
[*] Added [drumroll] a Reset Shard option! When you choose "Abandon Shard" you can now choose between returning to the Hub World or restarting your current Shard with the same settings. To everyone who already completed "The Machine": we're deeply sorry.,
[*] Endless music now changes when the track ends, not immediately every 3 levels. Hope this better protects your sanity on those really long runs!,
[*] Added a setting to "Invert Look X-axis",
[*] Added a cool-looking opening screen to Shard Runs (This will make a lot of sense in the near future...........),
[/list]
[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Balance changes to a number of Shards. They were too hard at the start and too easy by the end!,
[*] Slightly reduced the damage from Black Hole Rocks and the Glow Thing in Void Fragments,,
[*] Reduced the damage of Snake's beam explosions by 20%,
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a bunch of missing localization for other languages than English,
[*] Timeline Refactor now also rewinds the End boss final machine timer,
[*] Rest Area and Shop: Dying immediately and losing one or more lives, and also skipping other levels, should not happen anymore,
[*] Items affecting Energy Gain Rate no longer affect energy usage rate (Wait, they did what??),
[*] Brittle Breastplate now triggers health loss on Bad landings too, not just Ok landings, since it was obviously hugely overpowered and desperately needed a nerf...,
[*] Fixed an issue where you would keep your items when saving and quitting to the main menu, then immediately swapping to and starting another save slot, where that new save slot does not have a run active (i.e. it's a new save slot, or you're in the hub world),
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/154b2c1b1134c0e59dace29ecd15eeac09f04f1e.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.d: Changes to the Snake Boss and fixes!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! Thank you once more for all the feedback that lets us improve the game, here is a new patch with fixes - if you missed it we also made several patches last week, including one patch adding a difficulty slider for those who want to go back to the original difficulty (hard) or have more forgiving runs. 

PATCH NOTES:[/h3]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the T2 and T3 snake speed to make reaching the head less frustrating. Removed the T3 snake homing missiles because they never really ended up being fun to play against. 
[*] Added two large smoke plumes that can be seen far from away to make the snake easier to track.
[*] Changed the VFX that appears when breaking end boss machine parts to make them not block player vision as much
[*] Added a slight burst of speed to the player when breaking a machine part to make the fight flow better
[*] Reduced the number of void spikes in the end boss fight
[*] Removed bad landings from colliding with an obstacle
[*] Improved some generations' situations where it would not generate slopes for the player to jump off from
[*] Made the rifts that can occur in some level generation have better slopes to jump off from
[*] Improved UI of the Encounters to support more languages and resolutions
[*] Made the time bombs in Ethereal/spike levels more visible
[*] Rebalanced some Agency Structures
[*] Increased the amount of items given during an endless run
[*] Increased the amount of anti-sparks given after an endless run 
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed vram memory leak when using DLSS
[*] Fixed "The Archivist" and "Shopocalypse" achievements
[*] Fixed a frame pacing issue that caused the snake to have a slight stutter when moving. It should appear perfectly smooth now. 
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the void spikes in the end boss to spawn too close to the machine parts.
[*] Fixed issue that caused end boss void spikes to not trigger close calls
[*] Fixed the generation of jumps before the most Agency structures
[/list]
[b]Modding: [/b]
[list]
[*] Generated mmhook bindings are now generated for private methods as well
[*] Settings menu now has scrollable tabs if there are a lot of tabs from mods
[*] Fixed *.hasteitem.json items not actually persisting past a scene load (sorry!)
[/list]
[b]speedrunning:[/b]
[list]
[*] Livesplit Autosplitter now has an option to split on winning the end boss
[/list]

notes.title: Haste Patch: Addressing your Feedback + Animated Trailer!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello everyone! This is the first Haste patch, fixing bugs and addressing some of the feedback we’ve gotten since the game came out. [/b][/h3]

[h3]FEEDBACK[/h3]

[b]We’re seeing your feedback and we’re listening! [/b]

Haste is too hard - we’re making some tweaks to fix that in this first patch. 

The team and our testers have been playing this game for three years and have lost sight of what it would feel like to play for the first time. We’re rectifying this now based on your brilliant feedback.

We also have more tweaks coming in the future!

(If you enjoy the game being really hard, don’t worry, we have something coming for you as well.)

[h3]PATCH NOTES[/h3]
[b]Changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Increased starting life from 2 to 3
[*] All items are cheaper
[*] Reduced the number of obstacles in fragments
[*] Player gets more Antisparks
[*] First tier of Antisparks upgrades are now cheaper
[*] In general, made items that give Sparks give more Sparks
[*] Made encounter challenges less common
[*] Made some really hard obstacles less common
[*] Made versions 2 and 3 of the Jumper boss easier
[*] Added a re-roll option in the shop
[*] Keep running mode now gets harder quicker
[*] Increased the frequency of shops
[*] Encounter challenges now don't take a life when you fail them (you can still die normally in them)
[*] You now cycle through all (valid) Challenges before you get one you've had before
[*] Captain will now always unlock before the end of shard 1
[*] Rebalanced the Sage's Cowl to make it more useful
[*] Added ability to abandon run in level select
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed portal in the shop not showing up
[*] Fixed issue where you no longer could talk to The Captain after getting the hourglass
[*] Fixed some obstacles not being harpoonable
[*] Fixed "On enter Fragment" items not triggering in bosses and the challenges
[*] Fixed language bugs
[*] Fixes bugs with statistics
[*] Fixed issues with Endless Shard text formatting in some languages
[*] Fixed text in all languages
[*] Fixed some items not being shown when talking to the Researcher
[*] Fixed some issues with the Sage's Cowl not working even though you had the energy for it
[*] Fixed issues with dying while going into the portal
[*] Fixed ability unlocks not working with controller
[/list]
[h3]ANIMATED TRAILER[/h3]

We also just released the animated trailer for the game!
[previewyoutube=1RzLlTF8Vwo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Please make sure to restart Steam and verify the integrity of the game files to get this update. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/2a2b46bfbc839fc2d4fc09d73c9b56768a8bc2de.png[/img]

notes.title: Haste is out now!
notes.content:
[h3]Haste is finally out! It’s been a long journey since our initial wobbler prototype in late [url=https://x.com/wilnyl/status/1437839610445451266?s=20]2021[/url], and we’re very excited to finally be able to share the full game with you all! [/h3]

[previewyoutube=dHoXrWIawxY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What to look forward to in the full game:[/h3]

[h3]FEATURES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Third-person high-speed running gameplay
[*] 10 Shards, each featuring a collection of procedurally generated levels that must be completed without fail to advance to the next Shard
[*] Items and Challenge levels that let you customise your build for each attempt to clear a Shard
[*] Spectacular biomes and 4 different bosses to discover
[*] 4 abilities to master
[*] An unlockable endless mode
[*] A story to explore and a lovable cast of characters to befriend
[/list]

[h3]Thank you to everyone who played the demo and helped us with the final feedback and motivation to get this game through the end portal! [/h3]

We hope you hit the ground running, (literally), and have a great time with Zoe's crew.

[b]For any questions, support, or bug reports, please post in the Steam forums or reach out to us at support@landfall.se!

Join the official [url=http://discord.gg/hastebrokenworlds]Discord[/url][/b]!

notes.title: HASTE Devblog #6: Stats, Mod Support & Much More!

The [b][url=https://discord.gg/hastebrokenworlds]HASTE Discord[/url][/b] is growing and we're so excited to see new demo players in there every day! notes.title: HASTE Devblog #5: Courier Timelapse & Thank You!!
notes.content:
[h3]We wanted to give a massive thank you to everyone who has been playing the HASTE demo![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/e397416d6e26854034c648f01ff295b8e239089f.png[/img]

We've received lots of helpful feedback and we're working hard to make the game even better, thanks to your comments and bug reports. So much love is being put into every element of HASTE, and we're super grateful to everyone who has taken the time to share their thoughts.

[b]At the moment, we're working on new items, improving the flow of the level select screen, trying out some sort of endless mode, more music, environment polish and loads of other stuff![/b]

If you haven't already, join the [url=https://discord.gg/hastebrokenworlds]HASTE Discord[/url] and let us know what you think! The HASTE devs are having a great time chatting with you all and sharing insights into the game's development, and we've been blown away by all the excitement for the full release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/f8e9d6578e91292306d8711c1e8738a85750fe28.png[/img]

[b]While we're busy locking in to finish the game (accurate depiction above), we wanted to share a timelapse of the incredible [url=https://www.youtube.com/savannahxyz]Savannah[/url] working on the Courier's model![/b]

[previewyoutube=0IDs19QuBU8;full][/previewyoutube]

Zoe (A.K.A the Courier) has changed a lot over the course of development, but we really love the look she has now, and our artists have done an amazing job bringing her to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/ec6723915404f9317cd6ff0124a66fe0c2583ea3.png[/img]

[h3]If you wanna learn more about the HASTE team, check out our [url=https://landfall.se/about]website![/url][/h3]

notes.title: The HASTE Demo is out!
notes.content:
[h2]Today's the day![/h2]

[b]We've officially launched our demo for Steam Next Fest and we're so excited for you all to try it out![/b]

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2940200/Haste_Broken_Worlds_Demo/?beta=1]Check it out here![/url][/h3]

[b]DEMO FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tutorial
[*] Small hub world
[*] One shard to complete
[*] One boss
[*] Challenges
[*] Story elements and NPCs
[/list]
Once you've completed the demo shard, the difficulty bumps up, so you can replay with a bit more challenge! (This only happens once; it won't continue getting harder each time.) If you want to try the initial difficulty again, you can clear your save in the settings menu and restart the demo!

[b]If you haven't already, feel free to join [url=https://discord.gg/hastebrokenworlds]our new HASTE Discord[/url] where you can chat about the game and ask the devs questions![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/46ce9f90f2b0269100da5d404a887af0574593aa.png[/img]

notes.title: Haste Demo and Discord!

notes.title: HASTE Devblog #4: Art Timelapse & Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

[b]In case you haven't heard already, we're working on a demo for HASTE! We're SO excited for you all to finally get your hands on the game and try out a little taste of it.[/b]

While the team is busy prepping the demo, we wanted to share a timelapse from one of the amazing artists working on the game. You can also check out Ink's work on [b][url=https://bsky.app/profile/inkelksun.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://x.com/inkelk]Twitter![/url][/b]

[previewyoutube=nKoYcRy8dP0;full][/previewyoutube]

In HASTE: Broken Worlds, [b]Riza (A.K.A the Keeper)[/b] is an enthusiastic observer of the Courier's adventure. She takes notes and asks about everything, with an uncanny ability to show up wherever something exciting is about to happen. Despite her seemingly genuine desire for friendship, she's unwilling to speak about where she's from and why she's cataloguing everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/a7acc8424c99b6fc50786f24cd4450537b3f69e0.png[/img]

[b]The Keeper is one of many NPCs in the game,[/b] and while the demo won't give you a full picture of everyone in the Courier's crew, we're super keen for you to get a taste of the narrative!

Some of you might remember seeing multiple playable characters in early versions of the game, and while the Courier is the only playable character now, we've kept the abilities that these other characters had! And all of them are still featured as NPCs in the story.

Make sure to follow us on our socials (linked below) if you wanna see more content showing off the game! :)

notes.title: HASTE Devblog #3: Long time no see!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone! It's been a while since we made an update on Steam about what's happening with HASTE, so let's get into it! [/h2]

For those of you who don't know, we temporarily paused parts of development because some of the HASTE team took time off to develop Content Warning.

You can check out Content Warning here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2881650/Content_Warning/

[h3][b]But since August, we've all been back working on HASTE![/b][/h3]

We kick-started development again by going on a month-long work trip to Mexico! Since the whole team is based all over the world, we were excited to work on the game together in one place and we made a lot of progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/288667d71334eac3b6747deb0af34cb3e0dff8c4.jpg[/img]
(Very serious team photo.)

Since then, it's been full steam ahead working on every aspect of the game. Lots of improvements and new content have been added, and we're really loving how the game is coming together. HASTE has changed a lot since the first concept, so we're excited to be showcasing more of the game in the coming months!

(We're also in the process of updating the store page info, so we can better describe what the game is now!)

If you follow us on other platforms you might have seen some of this already, but we wanted to share a taste of what we've been up to.

The Courier teams up with a whole crew of fun characters on her journey through HASTE, and our artists have been working hard on their designs and models. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/a7acc8424c99b6fc50786f24cd4450537b3f69e0.png[/img]

We've also been playing around with different character designs for the antagonists of the story. Some of these options have already been eliminated, but we wanted to share them anyway! Lots of ideas get thrown out or reworked throughout the development process, so it's fun to see the path that was taken to the final game (and to show off the incredible work of our artists!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/32741f12c41c6f1c7fe99af8834e23bf55cd2c04.png[/img]

In addition to characters, we've been refining different environments within the game. Here's a concept sketch of the Resting Area where you can heal up during a run!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/b95e171255470e9dafa1879b617ee63622e3afff.jpg[/img]

A number of different challenges will also pop up during your runs, each with its own illustration, like the one below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762838/46ce9f90f2b0269100da5d404a887af0574593aa.png[/img]

Here's a clip of a new biome we've added for certain levels: the Ethereal World.

[previewyoutube=ay7kxxP8oyM;full][/previewyoutube]

We've also been working on an ice world. The music changes with each biome and we're super excited to be giving a sneak peek of the soundtrack here!

[previewyoutube=00Xl-K7nLf4;full][/previewyoutube]

And lastly, we've been working on lots of items and abilities, like the grappling hook we've been testing out.

[previewyoutube=cDETroLu-rw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]
Please keep in mind that the game is still under development so everything shown here might not end up in the final build.

We're super keen to be back focusing on HASTE and we can't wait to share more with you all! :) 
 [/h3]

notes.title: HASTE devblog #2 and new game Content Warning Free for 24h!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! We've been busy working on the game, trying out new things, creating art, writing story and animating characters etc! More info about what we've been working on further down![/h3]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2881650/Content_Warning/]Content Warning released for free today![/url][/b]

Some of the HASTE team have also participated in the annual Landfall April Fool's tradition of creating and releasing a game, you can find this year's game Content Warning here on steam: 

The game is free for the first 24h and then paid from April 2nd 9AM PT - it's not HASTE but it is a fun game for you and your friends to pass the time until you can run really fast :) Post the 24h free period the game will cost 7.99USD

Trailer below: 
[previewyoutube=1LTS0Me6MR4;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2881650/Content_Warning/][h3]Get the game here.[/h3][/url]
